description: He wears a long dark plum textured outer coat with full sleeves, an open front and gold patterned woven edging along the opening, cuffs and hem. Underneath is a warm ivory linen tunic with a short split neckline and subtle embroidery around the collar and front. A brown and gold decorated belt with a round buckle secures the coat at the waist. A dark plum mantle hangs from one shoulder, held by a circular gold clasp. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. His head is uncovered, and he carries no armor or weapons.
